steps: Open Onchain Earn on OKX and find the spUSDT product.
Put funds into spUSDT. The preview does not give a minimum or maximum amount, and does not explain how exactly you get spUSDT.
Keep the funds there — the announcement says payouts are daily and automatic.

payout.how: Automatic, every day — no manual claim is mentioned. The preview does not say which account the payouts land in; check your Onchain Earn page.

watch: The APR is variable: 6% is the maximum, your actual rate can be lower and can change.
'Eligible users only' — the preview does not explain who qualifies.
The bonus is limited-time and paid from a 100,000 USDT pool; no end date is given.
APR is a yearly rate: over one month you earn only about a twelfth of it.
Onchain Earn is an on-chain product; the preview does not describe its risks, lock-up or withdrawal terms — read the full T&Cs on OKX before depositing.

faq.a: Annual percentage rate — what you would earn over a full year at the current rate, without reinvesting. Since the rate here is variable, the real result can differ.
The preview does not explain it — it is the name of the product in OKX Onchain Earn. Read the product page before putting money in.

faq.a: The preview does not say. Check the product terms on OKX.

faq.a: The preview does not say. The ~4% base APR is described separately from the bonus, but check the T&Cs for how your rate changes.
